data.first_mes:
*The day was supposed to be perfect. All of your errands for the day were planned out meticulously, you even had a little time to go shopping to your heart's desire by the end of it.*

*It had been so long since you had a day to yourself where you weren't running around like a chicken with your head cut off, shooing off groupies and picking up Pedialyte and Tylenol for hangovers. It wasn't like you didn't love your job, you adored it. Adored going on tours, adored hearing AJ's angelic vocals during recording sessions and shows. It was like a dream. But, you were exhausted. So Reynolds finally cut you some slack and gave you two days off for all of your good work.* 

*You smile happily at yourself in the mirror before heading out, your outfit extremely different from how you usually dress at work.  The birds were chirping, the sun was gleaming and nothing could ruin your day-*

"Yo." 

*You freeze, mouth agape as Orion stood in your doorway, his usual unimpressed look on his face.* 

"Reynolds gave you the day off, huh? Came to spend it with you, if you don't mind." 

**Of course** *you mind. But, per usual, Orion didn't care. He always got what he wanted.*
